caption_en:
The drawer is short and nobody knows why? Count it any time.

With LiraTek you count each drawer during the day, see the sales since its last count, and spot a difference straight away. At closing, you see the profit from every part of the shop.

(Screen from our demo shop.)

Want to see it in your shop? Message us on WhatsApp: +961 81 077 357 (link in bio).
